decisions.reason: As a 2023 niche addition within the firm’s established spraying business, it benefits from technical fit and accumulated launch commitment, making management likely to persist and explain any weaker demand as temporary.
This low-pressure injection pump is very close to the core offer and had a dedicated product presentation, so sunk development effort and visible commitment strongly favor retention.

Because this is a multi-model pump line built on the firm’s core capabilities, the scale of investment and portfolio relevance make withdrawal especially unlikely under an escalation-of-commitment logic.

Its dedicated market presence and connection to the firm’s stated move toward more digitalized, interoperable production solutions give management reasons to stay the course despite any early uncertainty.

Although newer and less visibly committed than some 2023 launches, this hydraulic two-component spraying system is still close to the established business, so management would more likely continue than reverse the launch quickly.
